messages:
Oliver: Stream's up! Grab snacks and a beverage. Live link: https://meet.redwood/inference-all-hands — and yes, somebody queued a surprise banjo cameo 😂
all-hands-bot: Live captioning ON. Recording started. :redwood:
Jordan: Banjo cameo = instant mood boost :banjo: :clap:
Elaine: My coffee did a spit-take during the mic drop lol
Sam: Confetti overlay is slowly claiming my camera :sweat_smile:
Mike: Huge props to infra for the smooth demo — that fallback worked perfectly :tada:
Rachel: Quick poll — post-all-hands treat? donuts / bagels / tacos / salad
Tog: Bagels + schmear all the way :bagel: :raised_hands:
Deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: demo-staging (sha: abc1234) :rocket:
Jordan: Also anyone else cry at the pupper cameo? the tiny woof at 00:23 hit different :sob:
Elaine: https://giphy.com/pupper-cute — sending the gif for healing
Oliver: Banjo -> pupper -> confetti sequence is peak company culture :heart_eyes:
Sam: +1 to bagels, and also to more cameo pets in future all-hands
Rachel: Ordering bagels now, will send options poll in #lunch-plans :yum:
Mike: Thank you! also for the team who set up captioning — huge accessibility win :clap:
Tog: :thumbsup: :party_parrot:
Oliver: Okay wrapping up — see y'all for encore cookie distribution (virtual) :cookie:
